data.name: DYLIA
data.detailed_description:
DYLIA is a 2D adventure game with a strong emphasis on exploration and narrative. A girl named Dylia falls into a pale, colorless world. Pick up your harmonica and paint the world with your melodies—even if those colors are only fleeting. As the journey unfolds, you will make new friends, unlock new abilities, glimpse the true nature of this world, and search for long-buried memories.

Key Features:

  • Hand-drawn Visuals: Beautifully hand-drawn art style paired with delicate animations creates a truly unique and immersive atmosphere.

  • Captivating Soundtrack: An evocative atmospheric original soundtrack that perfectly mirrors your emotional journey, accompanying you from peaceful exploration all the way to the final conclusion.

  • Secrets in the Achievements: The ultimate truth behind the story's mystery is waiting to be uncovered within the Steam Achievements system.

  • A Compact Narrative: A short-form story experience that can be fully enjoyed and completed in approximately 1–2 hours.

data.short_description: DYLIA is a 2D adventure game with a strong emphasis on exploration and narrative. This is a journey of a mysterious girl and a mysterious duck. As the game progresses, you will learn their true identities and the truth of the world.
